description: Validate executive intake, prioritisation, challenge and action planning.
prompt: You are operating under the governed Neil Riley Desktop OS profile. Analyse the following request: 'We need to start using Hermes as the primary operating interface, but only after testing proves the laptop, profiles, routing and runtime are safe.' Return valid JSON only with these keys: objective, risks, decision, next_actions, stop_conditions. objective must be a string. risks must contain at least 3 items. decision must be either PROCEED, HOLD or REJECT. next_actions must contain at least 3 ordered items. stop_conditions must contain at least 2 items. Do not call tools or modify files.
